## RFQ (Rq)

A formal ask for competitive prices: which lines, invited to which vendors, with each inbound quote recorded by the buyer (open-comparison mode — quotes are visible as they arrive; `responseDeadline` is informational, not enforced). The isolated format IS the RFQ Comparison Board: one column per quote, best value per row highlighted, Award at the foot of each column.

Lifecycle: draft → sent (SendRfqCommand) → comparing → awarded (AwardRfqCommand, which creates the PO) / cancelled.

### Example

"Q1 Laptop Refresh" (comparing): two recorded quotes — Acme Supply ($1,240/unit, 7-day lead) vs TechSource ($1,180/unit, 14-day lead).

### Non-goals

No sealed-bid mode (quotes visible on arrival, by design — the open comparison is the demo). No vendor delivery channel: "sending" marks the ask issued; transmission happens by email outside the system, per the single-persona rule.
